# 🛠️ Maintenance Checklist

## Source and report
- [ ] Workbook schema and source path checked.
- [ ] Refresh completed.
- [ ] Key totals reconciled.
- [ ] Relationships and date logic reviewed.
- [ ] Measures and visuals checked.

## Quality and governance
- [ ] Accessibility reviewed after visual changes.
- [ ] Sensitive data and sharing permissions reviewed.
- [ ] Known issues and technical debt updated.
- [ ] Documentation links and diagrams validated.
- [ ] Workflow permissions and action versions reviewed.
- [ ] Backup and rollback copy retained.

## Record
Date, maintainer, PBIX/XLSX versions, issues found, actions, and next review date.
